# Sell 80.00 USD of the 100.00 USD an overpayment brought into Assets:Bank:USD.
#
# Load after tests/fixtures/fx_invoice_usd_overpaid_into_usd_bank.txt, with
# tests/fixtures/fx_rates_usd_dated.yaml: INV-USD-OVER bills 100.00 USD and is
# paid 200.00 USD on 2026-02-25 at 1.37. The bank's split opens an asset cost
# basis of the 100.00 USD past the invoice, at 1.37; `{basis}` is its guid.
#
# 80.00 USD at 1.37 cost 109.60 CAD and fetch 112.00 CAD, so the bank's cost
# basis is left at 20.00 USD and Income:FX Gain takes the 2.40 CAD difference.
2026-02-28 * "Sell 80 USD the overpayment brought in"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -80.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-109.60"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis}"
	Assets:Bank 112.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "112.00"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
